items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: That's not the same as Raymond Clifford.

ctx.x: Vernon Gilbert. And me, him, Vernon Gilbert, Tillman. Playing what? Tillman playing bass, you know. Mm-hmm. Bass horn, you know, like he playing the Vernon Gilbert trumpet. You know, clarinet. And, um, well, he had a saxophonian, Handy playing with him. Pretty good while, Handy playing with him a good while. Um, and after Handy stopped playing with him, and I had Harold. Mm-hmm. Harold been playing with him. He was Smitty on piano. And he used the piano, you know what I'm saying? Did he use a guitar player…
That's not the same as Raymond Clifford. No, no.
He's another Clifford Brown. He stayed downtown. It's in Antony Street. That was his regular guitar player. Clifford. I see. So he's changed up some to his band now.
